dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: Please do remember to take appropriate precautions and put on protective gear before using these in the field...

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: #Oh? {NICKNAME}, I didn't know you were interested in vintage muskets?

dialogues.speaker: Wislawa
dialogues.text: You're free to browse, but someone of your abilities really does deserve a newer, high-end, custom model... along with a dedicated gunsmith to keep it in tip-top condition.
